style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Pre-lit Snowy Christmas Wreath & Garland Set
style.toneOfVoice: A wreath and garland in the same snowy finish, so your front door and the hallway behind it look like they were planned together. Both are dusted with a frosted finish and dressed with red berries and pinecones – traditional, without being fussy. Each piece carries 50 warm white micro LEDs woven through the foliage, so there are no separate lights to thread or hide. Both run on batteries, so you are not limited to spots near a socket. Fan the branches out by hand once unpacked and you’re done. The wreath is suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use. The garland is best kept indoors or in a protected area. No hanging hook is supplied with the wreath. Batteries aren’t included – you’ll need three AA for each piece. Branches need fanning out by hand to look their best.
